newsitem.title: INDIA: TEXT - New India Export-Import Policy.
newsitem.headline: TEXT - New India Export-Import Policy.

text.p: The following is an extract of the text of the new Export Import Policy for 1997-2002:

The new Exim Policy 1997-2002 marks a further shift to a freer trade regime which can be seen in the removal of Quantitative Restrictions (QRs) on a number of items which include consumer items as well.
Import of about 542 items has been made liberal which includes about 150 items which can now be imported against SIL.

Likewise about 60 items which were hitherto importable under the SIL route have been moved to Free List. In other words import of about 542 items has been permitted either freely or under the SIL route.
Restrictions have been placed on a few items (5) on grounds of environmental safety, stragetic importance, public health or security reasons.
The broad outline of the above changes is as under:
FREE TO RESTRICTED:
* Battery scrap
* Sodium metal
* Australian Lupin seed
* Passive night vision goggles
* Fire and burglar alarms.
RESTRICTED TO FREE:
* Prunes
* Lobsters, shrimps and prawns, crabs, sea shell flesh, jelly fish etc.
* Chewing gum
* Corn flakes
* Crisp bread and ginger bread, sweet biscuits, wafers.
* Prepared or preserved tomatoes and truffles.
* Prepared or preserved nuts, pineapples prepared or preserved.
* Juices of grape, lemon, citrus, pineapple and tomatoes; tomato ketchup and soya sauce etc.
* Ice cream.
* HP and PX grade fertilizers.
* Tyres of motor cars, motor cycles, scooters, tractors including used and retreaded tyres; rubber tubes.
* Items relating to Professional grade audio video studio equipments and parts thereof.
* Calendars, posters and trade advertising material.
* Ships, refrigerated vessels, bulk carriers, dredger and floating docks etc.
* Jewellery boxes, and saddlery and harness of leather, cloth hangers, articles of paper mache, commercial catalogues.
* Ski boots, ski footwear and snow board boots; sports footwear with outsoles and uppers of rubber & plastic.
* Toughened safety glass, laminated glass, double walled glazed glass and glass cubes.
* Glassware of lead crystal of a kind used for table or kitchen purposes.
* Sewing machines.
* Dentists, barbers or similar chairs.
* Artificial turf.
* Pocket lighters, table lighters, electronic lighters etc.
* Vaccum flask and casserol etc.
* Various types of artware.
SIL TO FREE:
* Hair dyes, lall oil, pine oil, wood tar oil.
* Articles of natural cork, paper for far machines and self-copying papers.
* Musical instruments, all types.
* Diesel Generating sets upto 1500 KVA capacity.
* Video telephones.
* Fishing rods, fishing tackle, fish landing nets etc.
* Glassware of a kind used for toilet, office, in-door decoration or similar purposes, of lead crystal.
* Lawn movers.
* Manually operated accounting machines, cash registers, postage franking, ticket issuing and similar machines.
RESTRICTED TO SIL:
* Processed cheese not containing animal rennet or animal fat.
* Natural honey.
* Diabetic coke.
* Meat of rabbits, few marine products, cereals, bakery products etc.
* Melted butter, milk for babies.
* Copper oxi-chloride, Di-methyl sulphate, shaving cream, medicated soaps, toilet soaps, polishes, creams for wooden furniture and floor etc.
* Medicated and toilet soaps.
* Pickles, chutneys, prepared and processed fruits, vegetables, soups, fruit squashes, chilly sauces, custard powder etc.
* Domestic sewing machines.
* Liquid glucose, fructose, sweetmeats, jams, jellies and marmalades.
* Floor coverings, wall or ceiling coverings of polymers of vinyl chloride and other plastics; sanitaryware of plastic.
* Travel goods, handbags, cases and container of leather.
* Sanitary towels, napkins sanitary articles of paper.
* Rubber footwears.
* Safety headgear including wigs.
* Reservoir, tanks, vats and similar containers of aluminium and copper.
* Water coolers.
* Weighing machines.
* Dumpers designed for off-highway use.
* Frames and mountings for spectacle, wooden furniture, plastic furniture, mattresses, sleeping bags etc.

* Dolls of wood, metal and plastics; carrom board; playing cards; chess set; articles for fun fare, table or parlour games; articles of Christmas festivities, Carnival and other entertainment articles.
* Footballs, volleyballs, basket balls, badminton shuttle cocks, requisites of cricket and football, hockey sticks and blades of other sports equipments.
* Brushes for the application of cosmetics.
(Details are available in the ITC (IIS) Classifications of Export and Import Items Book).
